description: This file defines the ElementHandle class which represents an element in the DOM within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for interacting with DOM elements such as clicking, typing, scrolling, and evaluating scripts. The class extends JSHandle and implements specific element-related functionalities. It also includes utility functions for handling options and input files related to element interactions.

classes.name: ElementHandle
classes.description: Represents an element handle for DOM elements in Playwright, providing methods for element interaction.
